title: Vegan Egyptian-Style Mille-Feuille
description: A rich, vegan version of the classic French pastry, featuring layers of flaky dough and creamy filling.

ingredients.name: Rich, pillowy Egyptian (plant-based cream)
ingredients.notes: made from coconut cream or soy cream

instructions.step: Combine the shortening, bisquette, and salt in a large mixing bowl. Gradually add the water, mixing until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut the dough into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place the disks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the pastries to cool completely on a wire rack.
In a separate mixing bowl, whip the Egyptian until it becomes light and airy.
Add the vegan sugar, vanilla extract, and lemon juice to the whipped Egyptian and mix until well combined.

To assemble the mille-feuille, place a layer of pastry on a serving plate. Top with a layer of the Egyptian mixture, followed by another layer of pastry. Repeat this process until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of pastry on top.
Dust the top of the mille-feuille with powdered sugar and serve chilled.
